zh.title: 華航9/16起再漲貨運燃油附加費
zh.summary: 中華航空調漲貨運燃油附加費，反映國際油價
body: 中華航空向貨運代理商發布通知，自9月16日凌晨零時起調漲台灣地區出口貨物燃油附加費，以反映國際油價波動。
歐美長程航線調漲至每公斤新台幣62元，漲幅約6.9%；亞洲短程航線調漲至每公斤21元，漲幅約5%。
華航先前在9月初已將長程線貨運燃油附加費調升至58元、短程線調升至20元，此次再度調漲，反映航空燃油成本壓力持續升高。
華航說明，除基本運價貨物不予徵收外，其餘出口貨物均按計價重量徵收燃油附加費。

en.title: China Airlines to Raise Cargo Fuel Surcharge Again from Sept 16
en.summary: China Airlines raises cargo fuel surcharge from Sept 16 on oil costs
body: China Airlines has notified freight forwarders that it will raise the fuel surcharge for exported cargo from Taiwan from midnight on September 16, citing international oil price movements.

For long-haul routes to Europe and the Americas, the surcharge will rise to NT$62 per kilogram, an increase of about 6.9%. For short-haul routes in Asia, it will rise to NT$21 per kilogram, up about 5%.
The airline had already raised the long-haul cargo fuel surcharge to NT$58 and short-haul to NT$20 in early September. This further increase reflects persistent pressure from rising jet fuel costs.
China Airlines stated that except for cargo charged at basic freight rates, all other export cargo will be subject to the fuel surcharge based on chargeable weight.

zh.title: 波音767貨機邁阿密機場衝出跑道釀5死
zh.summary: 亞馬遜航空貨機於邁阿密機場降落時衝出跑道，撞擊車輛導致五人死亡。
body: 2026年9月6日，一架由21 Air替亞馬遜航空（Amazon Air）代為操作的波音（Boeing）767-300型貨機（註冊號為N1997A），在邁阿密國際機場（MIA）降落時衝出30號跑道。這架執行7598號班機的貨機，當天自波多黎各聖胡安的路易斯·穆尼奧斯·馬林國際機場起飛，經歷約兩小時十一分鐘的飛行後，於當地時間下午1時53分左右降落，隨後不幸發生衝出跑道的嚴重事故。
根據Flightradar24的航班追蹤數據顯示，該架貨機在脫離可用跑道表面時，其地面速度仍高達112節（相當於每小時129英里或207公里）。強大的動能使飛機直接衝破了跑道安全區及機場外圍的圍籬，一路衝入公路上並撞擊多輛行駛與停放的車輛，最終停在亞馬遜倉庫附近的停車場旁。事故發生後，飛機機頭著地且機身嚴重受損，並一度起火燃燒，現場伴隨嚴重的燃料外洩。
此次悲劇造成現場至少五人死亡、五人受傷，其中三名送醫的傷者目前情況危急。邁阿密戴德消防救援局在接獲報案後立即動員，派出超過60個救援單位及約200名消防與搜救人員趕往現場處置。救援人員從被飛機撞擊壓毀的車輛下方救出受困民眾，並對現場洩漏的燃料進行防護與圍阻。機上的兩名飛行員在本次事故中幸免於難，但當局尚未公佈死者的具體身份，也未說明罹難者是機上人員還是地面民眾。

事故發生時，邁阿密當地的氣象觀測報告顯示機場上空有雷雨，風向190度、風速17節，陣風達到26節。潮濕的跑道表面與降雨環境將成為調查的重點之一。美國國家運輸安全委員會（NTSB）已派遣由主席珍妮佛·霍曼迪（Jennifer Homendy）率領的調查小組抵達邁阿密現場展開調查，飛機製造商波音公司也已對此項調查提供支援。調查人員預計將對飛機的著陸點、反推力裝置與減速板性能、防滑功能及 landing 載重等數據進行全面檢視。

en.title: Amazon Air Boeing 767 Freighter Overruns Runway in Miami Killing Five
en.summary: An Amazon Air Boeing 767 freighter overran a Miami runway, striking vehicles and killing five people.
body: On September 6, 2026, a Boeing 767-300 freighter operated by 21 Air on behalf of Amazon Air overran Runway 30 during landing at Miami International Airport (MIA). The aircraft, operating as Flight 7598 with registration N1997A, had departed from Luis Muñoz Marín International Airport (SJU) in San Juan, Puerto Rico, for a flight of two hours and eleven minutes, touching down in Miami at approximately 13:53 local time before failing to stop on the runway.

Flight tracking data from Flightradar24 indicated that the cargo aircraft was still traveling at a ground speed of 112 knots (approximately 129 mph) as it left the usable runway surface. This substantial remaining energy propelled the aircraft beyond the runway safety area and the perimeter fence, carrying it onto a public road where it struck multiple vehicles. The freighter ultimately came to rest near a parking lot serving an Amazon warehouse, sustaining severe damage and catching fire.

The accident resulted in at least five fatalities and five other injuries, with three of those transported to medical facilities remaining in critical condition. Miami-Dade Fire Rescue responded to the emergency with over 60 units and approximately 200 personnel, extricating trapped individuals from under the impacted vehicles and managing a hazardous fuel leak. Both pilots on board the aircraft survived the overrun, and local authorities have not yet confirmed whether the deceased were on the ground or inside the plane.

At the time of the landing, meteorological reports indicated active thunderstorms over the airport, with winds of 17 knots gusting to 26 knots, and wet runway conditions. The National Transportation Safety Board (NTSB) has launched a formal safety investigation, with a go-team led by Chair Jennifer Homendy arriving on site. Investigators will focus on several factors, including the touchdown point, anti-skid systems, braking performance, and the operation of thrust reversers and spoilers under wet conditions.

zh.title: Simple Flying評選六家最傑出經濟艙餐飲航空
zh.summary: Simple Flying公佈六家最傑出經濟艙餐飲航空且皆位於亞洲
body: 航空媒體 Simple Flying 於 2026 年 9 月 7 日發表了一篇報導，列出 2026 年全球客艙中擁有最傑出經濟艙餐飲服務的六家航空公司。根據該媒體報導，這六家獲選提供最優秀經濟艙機上餐點服務的航空公司，其總部全部都是位於亞洲地區。
此項評選結果反映出亞洲地區的航空公司在經濟艙的餐點與客艙服務品質上，普遍獲得了該媒體的高度肯定。雖然全球各地的航空公司都在積極提升乘客的機上體驗，但此次公布的傑出餐飲名單顯示，亞洲籍的航空公司在經濟艙餐飲領域仍具有顯著的優勢。

en.title: Simple Flying Lists Six Airlines With Best Inflight Economy Meal Service

body: Aviation media outlet Simple Flying published a report on September 7, 2026, highlighting six airlines that offer the world's most outstanding inflight economy meal service in 2026. According to the publication, all six of the selected airlines that achieved this recognition are based in Asia.

The report underscores the strong performance of Asian carriers in providing high-quality economy class dining experiences to passengers. While airlines worldwide compete to enhance passenger comfort and onboard service standards, this selection indicates that Asian operators are leading in the category of economy cabin meal services.

zh.title: 荷蘭飛行車開發商PAL-V獲EASA生產組織批准
zh.summary: 荷蘭飛行車開發商PAL-V獲歐洲生產組織批准，預計2028年開始交付產品。
body: 荷蘭飛行車開發商 PAL-V 於 2026 年 9 月 7 日證實，該公司已獲得歐洲航空安全局（EASA）頒發的歐洲生產組織批准書（POA）。PAL-V 表示，這項批准是將其經過認證的「FlyDrive」移動解決方案推向市場的重要一步。該開發商聲稱，自己是先進空中交通（AAM）領域中首家獲得此類批准的 FlyDrive 開發商。
PAL-V 執行長 Robert Dingemanse 表示，獲得 POA 批准對該公司而言是一項重大里程碑。他指出，這證實了該公司不僅開發出突破性的產品平台，也建立了一個具備開發、認證和製造適航產品能力的國際級組織。在此之前，該開發商已取得數項關鍵認證，包括在 2025 年獲得 EASA 頒發的「無技術反對」（No Technical Objection）聲明。
這家總部位於荷蘭拉姆斯東克斯費爾（Raamsdonksveer）的開發商，同時也持有汽車生產批准，使其能夠在工業規模上製造其產品。PAL-V 預計將於 2028 年開始首批飛行車的交付。根據該公司說法，目前的預訂訂單量已足夠填滿前三年的產能。
在 2024 年 3 月，PAL-V 曾獲得總部位於杜拜的航太公司 Aviterra 所下達的 100 輛飛行車訂單，該公司得到了商務航空業者 Jetex 所有者的支持。在飛行狀態下，PAL-V 飛行車的航程可達 500 公里，最大飛行速度可達每小時 180 公里。

en.title: Dutch Flying Car Developer PAL-V Gains EASA Production Organization Approval
en.summary: PAL-V secures EASA production approval for its flying cars ahead of planned 2028 deliveries.
body: Dutch flying car developer PAL-V confirmed on September 7, 2026, that it has obtained its European Production Organization Approval (POA) from the European Aviation Safety Agency (EASA). The developer stated that the approval is a significant step toward bringing its certified FlyDrive mobility solutions to the market. According to PAL-V, it is the first FlyDrive developer within the Advanced Air Mobility (AAM) sector to gain this certification.

Robert Dingemanse, the Chief Executive Officer of PAL-V, stated that obtaining the POA is a major milestone for the company. He noted that the approval confirms the company has built an organization capable of developing, certifying, and manufacturing airworthy products. This development follows other certification milestones, including receiving a "No Technical Objection" statement from EASA in 2025.

PAL-V is headquartered in Raamsdonksveer, Netherlands. In addition to its newly acquired aviation approvals, the company also holds automotive production approvals. According to PAL-V, this dual approval allows the developer to manufacture its combined flight and road vehicles on an industrial scale.

The company expects to begin the first deliveries of its flying car in 2028. PAL-V reported that its current reservation portfolio is already sufficient to cover the first three years of production. This backlog includes a March 2024 order for 100 units of the flying car from Dubai-based aerospace firm Aviterra, which is backed by the owners of executive aviation firm Jetex.

In flight configuration, the PAL-V flying car has a reported operating range of 500 kilometers. The vehicle is also capable of reaching a maximum flight speed of 180 kilometers per hour. The company emphasized that its efforts extend beyond vehicle development to establishing a new category of mobility.

zh.title: 以色列航太完成空中巴士A330-300客改貨首飛
zh.summary: 以色列航太完成A330-300客改貨首飛，推進新型廣體貨機驗證認證程序。
body: 以色列航太工業（IAI）宣布，旗下改裝的空中巴士 A330-300 客機轉貨機（P2F）已成功完成首飛。本次試飛為 A330-300BDSF 計畫認證程序的一部分，旨在於多種營運條件下評估該架飛機及其系統表現。此一進展使 IAI 朝向認證這款專為區域與中程航線設計的新型廣體貨機平台邁進一步。
本次飛行是在 IAI 航空事業群完成該機型的主要結構改裝階段及廣泛地面測試後進行。在貨載能力方面，A330-300BDSF 經設計最多可容納 30 個集裝箱，最大載重能力達 61 公噸。該機型配備電動貨物裝卸系統與優化的貨物流線，並於主艙前段設置貨門，以提高裝卸作業效率並縮短地面過站時間。
IAI 總裁兼執行長 Guy Bar Lev 表示，此里程碑反映了公司在先進航空技術領域的持續投資，並進一步鞏固其在全球航空貨運市場的地位。他指出，A330-300BDSF 計畫擴大了 IAI 廣泛的改裝產品組合，並強化了為全球客戶提供長期、靈活且可靠解決方案的能力。
IAI 航空事業群副總裁兼總經理 Yaacov Berkovitz 指出，該計畫以滿足客戶對「快速投入服務」的核心需求進行設計，旨在支援客戶加速具備營運準備能力並提早實現營運收益。公司正運用數十年的工程專業知識，提供競爭力強的解決方案，以應對全球貨運市場不斷變化的需求。

IAI 從事客機轉貨機改裝業務已超過 45 年，範疇涵蓋窄體與廣體飛機平台。隨著 A330-300BDSF 計畫推動，該公司首次將空中巴士廣體客機納入其產品陣容，補充了既有的波音改裝平台，包括 B777-300ERSF、B767-200、B767-300、B737-700 以及 B737-800。先前 IAI 在波音 777-300ERSF 計畫中，曾成為全球首家取得該機型客改貨補充型別檢定證（STC）的公司。

en.title: Israel Aerospace Industries Completes Maiden Flight of Converted Airbus A330-300 Freighter
en.summary: Israel Aerospace Industries completes the maiden flight of its converted Airbus A330-300 freighter for certification.
body: Israel Aerospace Industries (IAI) has announced the completion of the maiden flight of its converted Airbus A330-300 passenger-to-freighter aircraft. Conducted as part of the official certification campaign for the A330-300BDSF program, the flight evaluated the modified aircraft and its onboard systems under multiple operational conditions. The milestone brings the company a step closer to certifying the new widebody cargo platform, which is designed primarily for regional and medium-haul operations.

The test flight followed the completion of the aircraft's primary structural phase and extensive ground testing carried out by IAI's Aviation Group. In terms of cargo specifications, the A330-300BDSF is designed to carry up to 30 containers with a maximum payload capability of up to 61 tons. The converted freighter features an electrical cargo loading system and optimized cargo flow, along with a forward-positioned main deck cargo door intended to accelerate loading and unloading while reducing operational turnaround times.

According to IAI President and CEO Guy Bar Lev, the milestone reflects the company's continued investment in advanced aviation technologies and strengthens its position in the global air cargo market. Bar Lev stated that the A330-300BDSF program further expands IAI's broad conversion portfolio and reinforces its ability to provide long-term, flexible, and reliable solutions to customers worldwide.

Yaacov Berkovitz, Executive Vice President and General Manager of IAI's Aviation Group, noted that the program is designed around speed to service to support accelerated operational readiness and earlier revenue realization for cargo operators. He highlighted that IAI is leveraging decades of engineering expertise to deliver a competitive solution tailored to the evolving needs of the global air cargo market.

IAI has been performing passenger-to-freighter conversions for more than 45 years across narrowbody and widebody aircraft platforms. The A330-300BDSF program adds an Airbus widebody to IAI's conversion lineup for the first time, joining its established Boeing conversion platforms, which include the B777-300ERSF, B767-200, B767-300, B737-700, and B737-800. The program follows IAI's B777-300ERSF project, where it became the first company globally to obtain a Supplemental Type Certificate for converting Boeing 777-300ER aircraft from passenger to freighter configuration.

zh.title: 澳洲布里斯本近郊輕型飛機墜毀 兩名機上人員罹難
zh.summary: 澳洲一架輕型飛機於布里斯本南郊墜毀；機上兩名人員不幸罹難；當局已展開調查
body: 澳洲昆士蘭州於2026年9月7日發生一起致命墜機事故。一架1979年製造的Beechcraft A36 Bonanza輕型單引擎活塞飛機（註冊號VH-MPT），於當日上午10時57分從布里斯本南部的阿徹菲爾德機場（YBAF）起飛，隨後墜毀在布里斯本南部洛根市（Logan）斯托克利（Stockleigh）的一處鄉村農地，並引發草地火災。
根據當地警方說法，墜機引發的火勢在一小時內被控制，地面無人受傷或房屋受損。然而，機上的兩名人員（據信為一名56歲男子與一名23歲女子）當場宣告死亡。澳洲安全調查機構已對此展開調查。
澳洲運輸安全局（ATSB）表示已啟動安全調查，並從布里斯本辦公室派遣了三名調查員前往現場，進行殘骸檢驗並蒐集飛行與維護紀錄，預計將在約八週後發布初步報告。

en.title: Two Killed After Beechcraft Bonanza Crashes Near Brisbane, Australia
en.summary: A Telford Aviation Beechcraft Bonanza crashed near Brisbane, killing two occupants on September 7.
body: A fatal aviation accident occurred south of Brisbane, Australia, on September 7, 2026. A 1979-built Beechcraft A36 Bonanza light aircraft, registered as VH-MPT, departed Archerfield Airport (YBAF) at 10:57 local time. Minutes later, the single-engine piston aircraft crashed onto a rural property in Stockleigh, Logan local government area, triggering a grass fire on the site.

The crash killed both occupants on board, believed to be a 56-year-old man and a 23-year-old woman. Emergency responders declared them dead at the scene. No one on the ground was injured, and no homes were damaged. The grass fire was successfully contained within approximately one hour.

The Australian Transport Safety Bureau (ATSB) has launched a safety investigation and deployed three investigators from Brisbane to examine the wreckage. A preliminary report is expected to be published in about eight weeks.

zh.title: 阿聯酋航空10月暫停荷蘭A380航班 11月服務將翻倍
zh.summary: 阿聯酋航空10月暫停荷蘭A380客機航班；11月起航線服務預計翻倍
body: 根據 Simple Flying 於2026年9月7日發布的報導，阿聯酋航空（Emirates）規劃調整其飛往荷蘭的客運航班營運。該航空公司旗下的空中巴士A380客機，於2026年10月期間將不再執行飛往荷蘭的航班，但該機型服務預計於同年11月翻倍恢復營運。
過往歷史紀錄顯示，阿聯酋航空於2026年夏季期間，曾暫時暫停前往布拉格與格拉斯哥的空中巴士A380航班服務。該航空公司先前規劃於2026年10月恢復這兩個歐洲航點的每日空中巴士A380巨無霸客機服務。

en.title: Emirates to Suspend Netherlands Airbus A380 Flights in October Before Doubling Service in November
en.summary: Emirates will suspend Airbus A380 flights to the Netherlands in October before doubling services in November.
body: According to a report published by Simple Flying on September 7, 2026, Emirates is planning adjustments to its passenger flight operations to the Netherlands. The airline's Airbus A380 aircraft will no longer operate flights to the Netherlands during October 2026, but services using the aircraft type are scheduled to double in November 2026.

Verified historical context indicates that Emirates temporarily suspended Airbus A380 flights to Prague and Glasgow for the summer 2026 season. The airline planned for daily Airbus A380 superjumbo passenger services to resume for both European destinations in October 2026.
